core.name: C compiler, Make, Git and shell tools
linux: sudo apt-get install -y build-essential gdb valgrind make git curl

python.name: Python 3
linux: sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv

go.name: Go
go.note: The quick install gets the newest Go through mise, into your home folder. The apt package is older and also works for this track.

rust.name: Rust (rustc and cargo)
rust.note: rustup is the official installer. It puts everything in your home folder and needs no administrator rights.

php.name: PHP
linux: sudo apt-get install -y php-cli php-sqlite3 php-mbstring php-xml php-curl composer
php.note: php-sqlite3 adds the SQLite driver that the database lesson uses.

mongodb.name: MongoDB
linux: # follow https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/administration/install-on-linux/ for your version of Ubuntu or Debian
mongodb.note: MongoDB is not in the standard Ubuntu packages: the quick install adds MongoDB's own package source first. The easiest route is Docker: the app starts a MongoDB container for you.

docker.name: Docker
linux: sudo usermod -aG docker "$USER"   # then log out and in
mac: brew install --cask docker   # then open Docker Desktop once
docker.note: On Windows install Docker Desktop and switch on its WSL integration (install.ps1 -Docker does the first part).
